name: Yixin Group Limited
summary: Yixin Group Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an online automobile finance transaction platform in China. The company operates in two segments, Transaction Platform Business and Self-Operated Financing Business. The Transaction Platform Business segment offers loan facilitation services, fintech/SaaS services, and other platform services, including guarantee services and value-added services. This segment also facilitates auto loans to consumers offered by its auto finance partners.
